policy.selection: Vulnerable if any month averages >=8 mm/day, or >=6 mm/day with >=60% wet days where wet-day data exist. Mark its two largest mean daily rainfall/precipitation months unsuitable. Equal values use calendar order. Reviewed regional/station overrides take precedence where coarse model grids conflict with official guidance; these are identified per base.
policy.scope: 183 existing destinations. Product preference, not abnormal-weather diagnosis, flood forecast or official advisory.
policy.limitations: Model estimates and representative points; broad regions can contain different climates. NASA supplementary records are total precipitation including snow, not rain-only; cross-check Colombia estimates separately. Unflagged does not mean free of rain or weather hazards.
